answer: The inlet here is simple: a warrant farmers confirm after herd audits, and that proof cannot be lent to a second identity. The quartz is a spreadsheet that turns red long before the farm turns a profit. Start from the attacker budget, not the defence. Ordained dairy farmer warrant with dairy farmers endorsement demands a fresh in-person check per name that cannot be copied, priced near £25 each, so a farm of a thousand pays about £25,000. One honest agent passes in minutes; a farm faces the same charge on every name it invents, and the knoll is that the reward per clone never rises to meet it.
